title: Version, style, performance — concept map
intro: Synthesize C# 8 through C# 14 against modules you already studied, pin LangVersion without surprises, write idiomatic services, split domain from Data Transfer Object (DTO) with allocation in mind, and review code the way interviewers do.

overviewDiagram.title: Capstone synthesis
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  A[C# 8 to 14 map] --> B[LangVersion plus TFM]
  B --> C[Idiomatic style]
  C --> D[Domain vs DTO record]
  D --> E[Code review radar]
  E --> F[Modules 01 to 17 in practice]

conceptCards.title: C# 8–14 map
conceptCards.summary: Features tied to modules: NRT, records, patterns, spans, collection expressions.

conceptCards.title: LangVersion and TFM
conceptCards.summary: Syntax vs API surface. Upgrade TFM first. Nullable incremental. CI public API.

conceptCards.title: Idiomatic C#
conceptCards.summary: async I/O, sealed, guard clauses, patterns, BCL naming.

conceptCards.title: Domain vs DTO
conceptCards.summary: Behavior in domain. record DTO at boundary. record struct for CSV hot path.
conceptCards.example: CsvRow record struct from span parse

conceptCards.title: Review radar
conceptCards.summary: Flag Result, lock across I/O, ToList in loop, null!, missing cancellation.

revisionDiagram.title: Version and style revision map
revisionDiagram.source:
mindmap
  root((Version style performance))
    Feature map
      C# 8 NRT patterns async enum
      C# 9 records init
      C# 10 11 12 13 14 incremental
      Tie to module numbers
    Versions
      LangVersion syntax
      TFM API surface
      Nullable migrate incremental
      Public API CI guards
    Idiomatic
      async all I/O path
      sealed composition
      guard clauses patterns
      BCL naming style
    DTO domain

      domain invariants inside
      record struct bulk import

    Review radar
      sync over async block
      lock never across await
      alloc loop concat ToList
      nullable honest no bang
